cohort: The study included 64 pregnant women in their 3rd trimester with lab-confirmed COVID-19 infection, and their neonates were followed for one year.
finding: The study found a higher rate of LSCS and 4.7% intrauterine deaths among COVID-19 positive pregnancies, but observed normal development in all babies during their first year of life.
mod_finding: A higher rate of LSCS (34.4%) was observed among the studied pregnant women.
